name: vind-runit
description: Stage scripts, service utilities and system commands (poweroff, reboot) for runit, used by Vind.
install: cd vind-runit && for f in utils/*; do install -D -m 0755 "$f" "$DESTDIR/etc/runit/utils/$(basename "$f")"; done
cd vind-runit && for service in service/*; do name="$(basename "$service")"; mkdir -p "$DESTDIR/etc/service/$name"; install -D -m 0755 "$service/run" "$DESTDIR/etc/service/$name/run"; done
cd vind-runit && for f in commands/*; do install -D -m 0755 "$f" "$DESTDIR$PREFIX/sbin/$(basename "$f")"; done
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
